items.title: Craftee’s Elemental Escape
items.creator: Logdotzip
items.description:
+ Fully voiced by Craftee
+ Elemental themed dungeons
+ Epic boss battles

Craftee is trapped and it’s up to you to free him. Harness fire, ice, and lightning. Burrow through solid rock, dash with the wind, and even stop time! Evade Mutant Wardens, Netherite Creepers, even laser beams. Only you can help Craftee escape!

items.title: Entity Horrors
items.creator: Mimic
items.description:
Pools of midnight for hides, gnashing teeth, and glowing eyes. Slip into the skin of one of these horrific entities!

• Includes 8 skins!
• Created by Mimic

items.title: Cyber Enders
items.creator: Mob Pie
items.description:
These enders have finally found a way to add a splash of color to themselves using the power of cyberspace! Vibe out as one of these brightly outlined endermen!
- Includes 8 skins!
- By Mob Pie

items.title: Neon Souls
items.creator: Mob Pie
items.description:
Shroud yourself in mystery, and cover yourself in vibrant glowing lines at the same time, with this stylized, ghostly skin set!

- Includes 8 skins!
- By Mob Pie

items.title: Glow Girls (HD)!
items.creator: CHRONICOVERRIDE LLC
items.description: Features 10 HD Girls in diverse styles and colors. Each one is crafted for a fresh look, perfect for any adventure. Find your favorite style and light up your game! One skin is completely free!

items.title: Super Anime Pack
items.creator: Eco Studios
items.description:
THE MULTIVERSE IS HERE! AND SO IS YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE! Get ready for a new game with a SUPER ANIME SKIN PACK and create YOUR OWN STORY!

- 21 ANIME SKINS (and 1 FREE)!

items.title: Strawberry Teens HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Strawberry Teens HD serves up sweet, summery vibes with juicy, berry-inspired fashion. These fresh fits blend playful reds and greens with a modern teen twist.

items.title: Spooky Guys
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
Join Halloween Monsters in their attempt to collect EPIC CANDY!

- There's no candy without a costume!
- 12 super spooky costumes!
- By RareLoot

items.title: Color Mobs
items.creator: Endorah
items.description:
Put on your most stylish clothes and get ready with your Color Mobs skins! Play with your friends with these cute skins and be the coolest!

+ 10 skins!
+ Perfect for roleplay!
+ Have Fun!
By Endorah

items.title: Desert Nether Knights
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
Left high and dry these warriors have risen from beneath the sandstone valleys. With fierce armor and powerful helmets that will be sure to rule the kingdoms! Fight with friends throught the Nether and become a knight with pure honor! 

+ Desert Nether Knights pack with 20 paladin skins! 
+ Become a Champion with 1 free skin! 
+ Perfect for Medieval!

By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Shadow Cloaks
items.creator: Hourglass Studios
items.description:
In the darkness cloaked shadows emerge! Powerful and scary souls are here to rule the overworld, who will you choose on this dark journey? 

+ Shadow Cloaks Pack with 22 Skins! 
+ Enter the shadow realm with 1 free skin! 

By: Hourglass Studios

items.title: Entity303 Dark
items.creator: Foxel Games
items.description: Enter a DARK legend with the Entity303 skin pack. Inspired by horror myths, these dark skins bring a chilling vibe. Perfect for horror fans!

items.title: Void Horror
items.creator: Foxel Games
items.description: Darknes arise around you!

items.title: Lava Mobs
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Burn through the battlefield with molten fury! The Lava Mobs Skin Pack transforms classic creatures into blazing, lava-powered beasts ready to scorch the overworld.
- 1 Free skin
- 12 Total Skin
Can you handle the heat?

items.title: Derp Agents
items.creator: Builders Horizon
items.description: Get ready for chaos with the Derp Agents! These not-so-smooth secret operatives bring laughter to every mission. Whether sneaking or stumbling, the Derp Agents always get the job done… eventually.

items.title: Goblins Vs Knights
items.creator: Ninja Block
items.description:
Choose your side! Become a daring knight or a clever goblins with unique skins, each ready for epic battles and adventures!

+ 5 different knights
+ 5 different goblins
+ Create your own adventure!

items.title: Modern City
items.creator: Dodo Studios
items.description:
- Play in this gigantic modern city! Use hundreds of custom furniture and vehicle models to fully customize the houses and the city itself!
- 6 modern city style skins included!

items.title: BLACK AND GOLD
items.creator: Ambient Creations
items.description:
5 Black and gold styled teen skins to show off in the next world or server you're in! Shine bright and flex on all your friends, these skins are stylish, shinny and awesome!

- By Ambient Creations

items.title: Shark Teens HD
items.creator: Wonder
items.description: Shark Teens HD brings a splash of ocean style with sleek, high-def shark-themed outfits. Dive into bold colors and fierce looks perfect for standing out.

items.title: Bunny House
items.creator: Carper Creative
items.description:
Hop into Bunny House! Retrieve GOLDEN CARROTS, conquer JUMPING TOWERS, deliver FARM SUPPLIES, and explore a CHARMING WORLD full of surprises. Solve puzzles, help rabbit friends, and enjoy cozy storytelling in this adorable quest adventure.

+ 4 SKINS

items.title: Expansion Plus Add-On
items.creator: Blockworks
items.description:
Expand your Minecraft experience with the Expansion Plus Add-On! There are hundreds of new features that can be used in your own worlds, from new blocks to food, mobs and more!

- 500+ new blocks
- 100+ new items
- 8 new mobs
- From: BlockWorks

items.title: Forest Fits
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description:
Step into the wilderness with style! This pack blends nature with fashion, featuring flowery designs, animal hoodies, and earthy tones.

- Contains 16 nature-inspired skins
- Perfect for outdoor adventures
- Embrace your wild side!

By Sandrinasis & Pathway Studios

items.title: Cat Expansion Add-On
items.creator: Bunny Studios
items.description:
Discover 20 amazing cats, each with their own special abilities! Ride, heal, enchant, or defend with your feline friends. Enjoy new armor, swords, and cozy furniture. Cat Expansion makes every adventure unforgettable!

+ 20 new cats 
+By Bunny Studios

items.title: DARK ANOMALIES
items.creator: Teplight
items.description:
Meet the DARK ANOMALIES skin pack! Scary, glowing monsters from the shadows are here. Look spooky and powerful, perfect for adventure, roleplay, or scare your friends!
- 60 skins
